The *Uppalavaṇṇātherīapadāna* (Thi-Ap 19) is a biographical verse text located in the *Therīapadāna* section of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. It recounts the meritorious deeds in past lives and the spiritual achievements of the eminent nun Uppalavaṇṇā, and is linked in the tradition to her verses preserved in the *Therīgāthā* (Thig 11.1, *Uppalavaṇṇātherīgāthā*) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records five modern translations across five languages for this text [SuttaCentral].
